description:
Cast Rograkh.
Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rograkh.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Rograkh dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {2}.
Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand.
Repeat.
